caption: Fort Amsterdam, Sint Eustatius
composition: Low ruined water-fort walls on the bay shore at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Fort Amsterdam is the Waterfort on the southwest shore of Oranjebaai. Only low brick ruins remain, and sections lost to the sea are not rebuilt. It is mainly clear, about 29.4°C, with wind near 21.1 km/h and cloud cover about 32%. The scenario uses America/Kralendijk. It is not the cliff battery and not Fort Oranje.
